svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower tube: cut 560 mm of 22 x 1.2 tube. Flatten the bottom 60 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in a vice to about 5 mm thick, off-centre so one face stays in line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the tube wall; drill two 8.5 mm holes 26 and 50 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom end. Set the flat about 10 degrees to the tube (the splay).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper tube: cut 490 mm. Flatten the top 40 mm, drill 6.5 mm 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the end, at right angles to the flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sleeve: 250 mm of 25 x 1.2 tube (22.6 mm bore). Pin holes 6.5 mm:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through sleeve and lower tube once; in the upper tube every 25 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over 250 mm, for 850 to 1,050 mm grip height.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lower flat on the rear drop plate's outside face, two M8 bolts;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a third hole, 6.5 mm, takes the drop plate's front rail bolt (it clamps the flat).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the upper tube slides in the sleeve by hand; pins go in freely.
